content.value_statement: Independent implementation tasks can lose quality when context and review steps drift. This skill coordinates fresh subagents, spec checks, and code quality reviews in one workflow.
actual_capabilities: Explains when same-session subagent execution fits independent implementation tasks.
Provides prompt templates for implementer, spec reviewer, and code quality reviewer subagents.
Defines a per-task loop from plan extraction through review approval.
Requires spec compliance review before code quality review begins.
Shows example handoffs for questions, fixes, re-review, and final approval.
Lists red flags for skipped reviews, overbuilding, and context gaps.
limitations: Does not execute subagents or commands by itself; the host agent must act.
Works best when tasks are independent and already defined in an implementation plan.
Requires careful human oversight when subagents modify code or create commits.
Does not replace project-specific security, testing, or release checks.

use_cases.title: Ship Independent Plan Tasks
use_cases.description: Coordinate feature tasks that can be implemented one at a time with review loops after each task.

use_cases.title: Tighten Spec Compliance
use_cases.description: Use a dedicated reviewer prompt to catch missing requirements, unrequested extras, and misunderstood acceptance criteria.

use_cases.title: Structure Solo AI Coding
use_cases.description: Give a solo developer a repeatable workflow for delegating implementation, review, fixes, and final branch checks.

prompt_templates.title: Start One Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Use subagent-driven-development for one independent task. Extract the full task text, dispatch an implementer, then run spec and quality reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Run A Small Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to execute my plan with three independent tasks. Keep the same session, track each task, and require both review stages.

prompt_templates.title: Recover From Review Issues
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply subagent-driven-development to continue after a reviewer found gaps. Send the issues back to the implementer, then repeat the correct review.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Final Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: After all tasks pass their reviews, use the final reviewer step and summarize remaining risks before branch completion.

output_examples.input: A user provides a feature plan with five mostly independent tasks.
output: A task list with each task copied with needed context.
A subagent handoff sequence for implementer, spec reviewer, and code reviewer.
A final review step after all tasks pass.

output_examples.input: A spec reviewer reports missing progress reporting and an extra flag.
output: The implementer receives exact review issues.
The extra work is removed and the missing requirement is added.
The spec reviewer checks the corrected task again.

output_examples.input: A subagent asks whether a hook should be installed at user or system scope.
output_examples.output: The controller pauses implementation, answers the question, and resumes only when the task is clear.

best_practices: Provide full task text and relevant context instead of making subagents search the plan.
Run spec compliance review before code quality review for every task.
Repeat fix and review loops until each reviewer explicitly approves.
anti_patterns: Dispatching multiple implementation subagents that may edit the same files.
Accepting an implementer report without reading the changed code.
Moving to the next task while review issues remain open.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when you have an implementation plan with tasks that can be completed mostly independently.

faq.question: Does it run code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance and prompt templates for the host agent to use.

faq.question: Why use a fresh subagent per task?
faq.answer: A fresh subagent reduces context drift and keeps each task focused on its exact requirements.

faq.question: Why are there two review stages?
faq.answer: Spec review checks whether the right thing was built. Code quality review checks whether it was built well.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What plan types fit poorly?
faq.answer: Highly coupled tasks, unclear requirements, or workflows needing constant human decisions fit poorly.
